usage.callShape: POST https://x402.tavily.com/search with JSON body {query, max_results}
usage.outputShape: body.results[].{url, title, content, score} — ranked web results with relevance scores; body.answer (null unless include_answer:true); body.response_time; body.request_id
quirks: answer and follow_up_questions are null by default — pass include_answer:true to get an AI-synthesized answer
raw_content is null by default — pass include_raw_content:true to get full page text
This is the direct x402.tavily.com backend (was previously needs-review/untested); confirmed working at $0.01 with the same schema as the Orthogonal proxy
usage.guide: POST {query, max_results} as JSON to https://x402.tavily.com/search. Returns body.results[] where each item has url, title, content (cleaned LLM-ready text), and a float score (0–1). Optional params: search_depth ('basic'|'advanced'), topic ('general'|'news'|'finance'), include_answer:true for an AI-synthesized answer in body.answer, include_raw_content:true for full page text. Pay-per-call x402 on Base at $0.01, plain synchronous response.
